name: B10-0280/2025 (The Left) – Case of Ahmadreza Djalali in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Dr Ahmadreza Djalali in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and asking Iran to cancel the death sentence against Ahmadreza Jalali, a Swedish-Iranian professor held since 2016. It asks for his release on health grounds, a proper investigation of his torture claims, and medical care. It also condemns Iran's rising use of executions, the holding of dual nationals as hostages, and Israel's military action against Iran on 13 June.

- No law changes; Parliament only states demands to Iran.
- Affects Jalali, other death row inmates, and dual nationals held in Iran.
- Next: the resolution is sent to EU institutions, member states and Iran.
